name: orchardcore-cli
description: Manage Orchard Core tenants through the OpenAPI-driven oc CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, model, and manage Orchard Core tenants.
interface.longDescription: Schema-first skills for authentication, content, media, templates, themes, settings, menus, and administration. Requires the oc executable and an authorized tenant context.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the capabilities of my Orchard Core tenant.
Create and validate an unpublished article draft.
Help me diagnose a denied management command.
